description: Fix ZaqWeb.Helpers.Timezone so an absent system timezone is cached as a valid result instead of causing one Engine/DB lookup per formatted timestamp. Preserve the existing Engine action boundary and process-local cache. Add a regression test proving repeated shifts issue one lookup. Action reuse assessment: reuse existing :system_config_get_system_timezone Engine operation; local-only cache-state distinction in the presentation helper because it has no standalone operation contract. Verify targeted timezone tests and mix q.

comments.text: Implemented explicit cache-miss handling so nil timezone values are cached per process. Regression test proves two shifts with an absent timezone invoke the loader once. Validation: targeted timezone/date-format tests 40/40 pass; mix q passes. mix precommit was rerun twice but remains blocked by unrelated existing peer-node tests (AuthRateLimiterPeerTest and ConfidentialEventPeerTest), which reproduce in isolation; initial run also had a transient onboarding async timeout that passed in isolation.

title: Cache missing system timezone per render process
